errors.title: Sensor Malfunction
errors.description: Robot's proximity sensor is not responding
steps: Stop the robot immediately using the emergency button
Check sensor cable connections at the base unit
Clean the sensor lens with a microfiber cloth
Restart the robot and run sensor diagnostics
If issue persists, replace the sensor module

errors.title: Low Battery Critical
errors.description: Battery level below 5% - immediate charging required
steps: Robot will auto-navigate to nearest charging station
Ensure charging dock is clear of obstacles
Monitor charging status - should reach 20% in 15 minutes
If not charging, check power supply to dock
Inspect charging contacts for debris or damage

errors.title: Path Obstruction Detected
errors.description: Robot cannot proceed due to blocked pathway
steps: Check robot's current location on the map
Manually clear any obstacles in the path
Press the 'Resume' button on the control panel
If error repeats, recalibrate navigation sensors
Update the warehouse map if new obstacles are permanent

errors.title: Motor Overheating
errors.description: Drive motor temperature exceeds safe operating limits
steps: Robot will automatically stop and cool down for 10 minutes
Check for debris blocking motor vents
Ensure ambient temperature is within 15-30°C range
Reduce payload if robot is consistently overloaded
Schedule maintenance for motor inspection

errors.title: Communication Lost
errors.description: Robot lost connection to central control system
steps: Check WiFi signal strength in robot's area
Verify warehouse router is operational
Restart the robot's communication module
Re-pair the robot with control system if needed
Contact IT support if network issues persist

errors.title: Payload Overload
steps: Stop robot and remove excess items immediately
Check payload weight against robot specifications
Redistribute items across multiple trips
Inspect load sensors for calibration issues
Update task planning to prevent future overloads

errors.title: Gripper Malfunction
errors.description: Robotic arm cannot pick or release items
steps: Manually release any stuck items
Check gripper hydraulic/pneumatic pressure
Test gripper controls in manual mode
Lubricate gripper joints if movement is stiff
Replace gripper pads if worn or damaged

errors.title: Navigation Error
errors.description: Robot position does not match expected coordinates
steps: Stop robot and note current displayed position
Use manual controls to move to a known reference point
Run full navigation system recalibration
Check for magnetic interference near robot path
Update warehouse floor map if layout changed

errors.title: Software Update Required
errors.description: Robot firmware is outdated and needs update
steps: Send robot to designated maintenance area
Connect to firmware update server
Do not interrupt update process (takes 5-10 minutes)
Robot will restart automatically after update
Verify new firmware version in system info

errors.title: Emergency Stop Activated
steps: Identify who pressed the emergency stop and why
Ensure area around robot is safe
Release emergency stop button by twisting clockwise
Press 'Reset' button on control panel
Manually restart robot operations

errors.title: Barcode Scanner Failure
errors.description: Cannot read item barcodes or QR codes
steps: Clean scanner lens with appropriate cleaning solution
Test scanner with known good barcode
Check scanner alignment and focus settings
Verify adequate lighting in scanning area
Replace scanner module if hardware failure confirmed

errors.title: Charging Station Occupied
steps: Check which robot is currently charging
Estimate time until dock becomes available
Direct robot to alternative charging station
Manually move other robot if priority charging needed
Consider adding more charging stations if recurring

errors.title: Wheel Slippage Detected
errors.description: Robot wheels losing traction on floor surface
steps: Inspect floor for wet spots or debris
Clean robot wheel treads
Check wheel tire condition for wear
Reduce robot speed in slippery areas
Report floor maintenance issues to facilities team

errors.title: Collision Avoidance Alert
errors.description: Near-miss with another robot or obstacle
steps: Review collision logs to understand incident
Check if obstacle was stationary or moving
Verify all safety sensors are functioning
Adjust robot speed or spacing rules if needed
No immediate action required if system prevented collision

errors.title: Task Queue Overflow
errors.description: Robot has too many pending tasks
steps: Review and prioritize current task list
Cancel or defer non-urgent tasks
Redistribute tasks to other available robots
Check for task assignment logic errors
Increase robot fleet size if consistently overwhelmed
